Smt Hanumavva W/O. Yaankappa Harijan vs Basavaraj S/O. Hanumanthappa Majjigi

Learned counsel for the appellants submits that some other relatives of the deceased had filed Miscellaneous First Appeal No.101689/2022, in which the compensation has been enhanced, and that the appellants herein are also beneficiaries of the same.
In view of the said circumstances, he submits that he does not press the present appeal.
The submission is placed on record, and accordingly, the present Miscellaneous First Appeal stands dismissed.
